cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Selling the stall at a loss paid for the knowledge we'll use to make the next one profitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make a shortlist. You can cross off anything that repeats our old costs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make me show you the profit on each option before you let me buy.
